short: A major battle where US Marines captured the heavily fortified island of Iwo Jima from the Japanese.
full:
On 19 February 1945, United States Marines launched an amphibious invasion of Iwo Jima, a tiny volcanic island situated about seven hundred miles south of Tokyo. The objective was to capture its three airfields to serve as an emergency landing site for B-29 bombers targeting the Japanese mainland. The defending Japanese forces had prepared an extensive network of underground bunkers, hidden artillery, and miles of interlocking tunnels, choosing a strategy of attrition rather than contesting the beaches.

The resulting battle was one of the bloodiest in the Pacific theater, lasting thirty-six days. It was the only major Pacific conflict where American casualties exceeded those of the Japanese, although nearly all the twenty-one thousand Japanese defenders were killed or chose suicide over surrender. The island was finally secured on 26 March, providing the US Army Air Forces with a vital forward base.
